mentions.name: VirtualZoo
mentions.description: A simulation in which a simulated organism develops its own small language purely through learning from sensory input, implementing the symbol grounding ideas from Stevan Harnad's 1990 symbol grounding problem paper.
mentions.problem: The symbol grounding problem: how symbols/language can emerge grounded in sensory input rather than being arbitrarily assigned (Harnad, 1990).
mentions.source_excerpt: I am trying to build a simulation that lets a simulated organism come up with its own small language, purely learned from sensory input

evidence.value: I am trying to build a simulation that lets a simulated organism come up with its own small language, purely learned from sensory input
